connector.name: Kweenkl MCP
connector.registryDescription: Push notifications for AI agents - send instant iPhone notifications from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.kweenkl.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the antoinedelorme account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: X-Kweenkl-Device-Token
headers.description: kweenkl device token (from the iOS app settings). Optional — only needed for channel management tools; sending notifications works with a channel webhook token, and OAuth login is also supported.
